description: Functions of the value type Move (E34). They work on the 16-bit value alone and need no board.

functions.name: create
functions.description: Builds a move from its parts. Squares above 63 and the unused flags 6 and 7 are invalid. The move is not checked against any position.

functions.name: from_value
functions.description: Wraps a raw 16-bit value, e.g. from a transposition table. Values outside 0 to 65535 or with flags 6 or 7 are invalid; NULL_MOVE and RESIGN are accepted.

functions.name: parse

returns.description: Flags 8 to 11 for a promotion, otherwise 0.

functions.description: Reads UCI notation without a board, so capture, castling, en passant and double push are unknown. Board.is_legal and Board.make_move therefore compare only from-square, to-square and promotion piece; Board.parse_move gives the complete move. 0000 is not accepted.

functions.name: from_square
functions.description: Bits 0 to 5. Named from_square because from is a keyword in Python.

functions.name: promotion
functions.description: Piece type the pawn turns into: (flags & 3) + 1 if flags >= 8.

functions.name: is_capture
functions.description: Flags 4, 5 and 12 to 15, i.e. including en passant.

functions.name: uci

returns.description: e.g. e2e4 or e7e8q; castling as king move e1g1.

functions.description: UCI notation. NULL_MOVE and RESIGN have none and raise InvalidArgument.
